title: fix(optimizer): close custom extension analysis bundles
body:
## What’s happening?

When Vite analyzes a dependency matched by `optimizeDeps.extensions`, it creates a temporary Rolldown build to inspect its exports.

Vite calls `build.generate()`, parses the generated output, and returns without closing that build.

A regression using an optimizer-only Rolldown plugin shows the mismatch:

```text
bundle starts: 2
bundle closes: 1
```

One build is used for custom-extension export analysis and another for the dependency prebundle. The export-analysis build remains open.

## What changes?

Wrap the export-analysis step in `try/finally` and call `await build.close()` in the `finally` block.

This closes the temporary build after successful analysis and when generation or parsing throws.

## Tests

Added `customExtensionBundleClose.spec.ts`, which uses a dependency with a `.notjs` extension and counts Rolldown `buildStart` and `closeBundle` calls.

The regression verifies that every started build is closed.

```sh
pnpm test-unit packages/vite/src/node/__tests__/optimizer/customExtensionBundleClose.spec.ts
```
